precision: 4 decimal places (about 7 m of longitude at 49 degrees N)
note: coast is the shoreline as open lines, not closed land polygons: the layer is linear and the mainland runs off every edge of the window. river is the outline of river polygons over 20 hectares, which closes. The Freshwater Atlas is a British Columbia layer, so there is no shoreline south of the international boundary. Fifteen of the window's 3,910 model cells sit in that strip.
